text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pouring everything she had built into the 
race, Katsuragi Ace won the Japanese 
Derby! Having conquered the heated battle, 
her joy explodes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, even after becoming a Derby 
Umamusume, public perception didn't 
change. She was still treated merely as a 
foil for Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s strength was simply on another 
level. Faced with that sheer gap, some 
umamusume even retired from the front 
lines.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's road ahead is harsh. Her 
Trainer vows to continue supporting her. 
Her next race—the third leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
